title: charging.events.v1
description: Synthetic vehicle charging telemetry event. Minor versions 1.x may add optional fields; consumers ignore unknown fields. Processors apply the stricter validation rules in docs/build-contract.md section 4.

vehicle_id.description: Synthetic, non-identifying vehicle key. Classification: vehicle_identifying.

energy_delivered_kwh.description: CUMULATIVE energy delivered since session start, not a per-event delta.

synthetic_location.description: Optional synthetic grid cell. Classification: sensitive_location. Restricted: must never appear in any output, log or error record.
